annotations.title: React to a message with an emoji

description:
Attach an emoji reaction to a message, or remove one.

Pass a single emoji character, e.g. `👍`. Passing an empty string
removes the reaction this number previously left. A new emoji
replaces this number's previous reaction rather than adding beside
it; to bring the earlier one back, react with it again.

Works on messages in either direction: reacting to something a customer
sent is often a cheaper acknowledgement than a reply.

The number first appears online and its unread messages in that
conversation are marked as read, then the reaction is sent.
Opening the conversation this way is automatic and uses no quota of its own.

Needs a plan that includes reactions. On a plan that does not, this
answers `payment_required: feature_not_available`, and the answer will
not change by retrying.

emoji.description: A single emoji, for example `👍`. An empty string removes the reaction this number left before.
